releases.notes:
## What's new

**Every Wrapped is now yours.** This release adds 18 axes of customisation, accessible through ModMenu → Configure (or `/wrapped config`).

### Customisation (configurable per axis)

**Visual**
- 11 color themes — Default, Nether, End, Ocean, Sakura, Halloween, Christmas, Vaporwave, Monochrome, Forest, Custom
- Custom RGB for bg-top / bg-bottom / accent / secondary accent (live hex editor)
- Gradient direction
- Custom hero title

**Content**
- Card picker — enable/disable each of the 14 cards individually
- Card reorder — ▲/▼ controls in the order screen
- Target month — replay any historical wrapped
- World filter — include/exclude specific worlds or servers (JSON-edit)

**Animation**
- Speed multiplier (0–2x, plus "Instant" mode)
- Sound volume slider
- Sparkle density (none / low / medium / high)
- Transition style (fade / slide / zoom / cut)

**Export**
- Aspect ratio (Story 9:16, Square 1:1, Landscape 16:9)
- Skin head + IGN watermark toggle
- Free-text signature line

**Privacy**
- Mask server names ("Server #N")
- Mask IGN

**Trigger**
- Auto-trigger on/off
- Grace window slider (1–31 days)

### Backward compatible

Every field defaults to v1.0 behaviour, so existing setups still work without touching the config. The config lives at `config/mcwrapped.json` and you can edit it manually if you prefer.

### Supported versions

| MC version | Jar |
|---|---|
| **1.21.11** | `minecraft-wrapped-1.1.0.jar` |
| 1.21.10 | `minecraft-wrapped-1.1.0+1.21.10.jar` |
| 1.21.8 | `minecraft-wrapped-1.1.0+1.21.8.jar` |
| 1.21.6 | `minecraft-wrapped-1.1.0+1.21.6.jar` |
| 1.21.4 | `minecraft-wrapped-1.1.0+1.21.4.jar` |
| 1.21.1 | `minecraft-wrapped-1.1.0+1.21.1.jar` |

ModMenu is **recommended** (the config screen is reachable from the mods list) but not required — `/wrapped config` works without it.

### Bug fixes since v1.0

- Hardened JSON parsing — malformed snapshot/wrapped files no longer crash the load
- AppleScript / PowerShell clipboard escaping for paths with quotes
- ESC handler in the wrapped screen, division-by-zero guard for minimised windows
- Sparkles no longer freeze when re-opening a wrapped in the same session
- Responsive config screen layout — adapts to any window size and GUI scale

First public release of **Minecraft Wrapped**.

## Downloads

| Minecraft | File | Loaders |
|---|---|---|
| 1.21.11 | `minecraft-wrapped-1.0.0.jar` | Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge (via Sinytra) |
| 1.21.10 | `minecraft-wrapped-1.0.0+1.21.10.jar` | Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge (via Sinytra) |
| 1.21.8  | `minecraft-wrapped-1.0.0+1.21.8.jar` | Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge (via Sinytra) |
| 1.21.6  | `minecraft-wrapped-1.0.0+1.21.6.jar` | Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge (via Sinytra) |
| 1.21.4  | `minecraft-wrapped-1.0.0+1.21.4.jar` | Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge (via Sinytra) |
| 1.21.1  | `minecraft-wrapped-1.0.0+1.21.1.jar` | Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge (via Sinytra) |

## Loaders
- **Fabric** + **Quilt**: native (drop the jar in `mods/`)
- **NeoForge**: install [Sinytra Connector](https://modrinth.com/mod/connector) first, then drop the jar in `mods/`

## Highlights
- 14 animated cards covering play time, social, dimensions, top blocks/mobs/crafts, longest session, time-of-day distribution, distance breakdown, archetype reveal, and a final recap with image export
- 100% client-side, zero telemetry — all data lives in \`<game>/wrapped/\`
- Title-screen button + in-game toast appear automatically on the 1st of each month
- Save Image / Copy / Close in the final card; copy-to-clipboard works on macOS, Linux and Windows
- Pause / skip controls via SPACE / arrow keys

## Commands
- \`/wrapped\` — replay the latest Wrapped
- \`/wrapped history\` — browse past Wrappeds
